title: RHC Entity V2 Identity
description: Minimal identity record for an Entity V2 entity: stable typed ID, type, display name, optional classification subtype, and optional references to other entities by ID. entity_type is the permanent identity type; subtype is an optional, non-identity classification label (e.g. a mutable role such as 'npc' or 'villain', or an ability/status_effect classification such as 'spell' or 'curse') and must never be baked into entity_id or entity_type. 'ability' is a persistent definition of something an entity can do or inherently has; 'status_effect' is a persistent definition of something that can be applied to an entity. Both are definitions only: activation semantics, action-economy cost, duration, stacking, and any runtime application of a status_effect to a specific target are out of scope here. Optional provenance (HB-01) is logistics-level origin classification of this authored record; it grants no canon authority, reader visibility, character knowledge, or gameplay behavior, is never inferred, and absence on legacy records is treated as unclassified/unknown. Does not describe owner state, knowledge, inventory, relationships, or any other subsystem.

provenance.description: Optional shared provenance classification of this authored record (HB-01). Exactly one of official, homebrew, adapted, unknown. Logistics metadata only: it grants no canon authority, reader visibility, character knowledge, or gameplay behavior, and is never inferred. Absence on legacy records is treated as unclassified/unknown until an explicit later classification event.
